description: The closed success schema does not bind each dependency checkedAt timestamp to the current run or the 15-minute freshness window. It requires only UTC syntax while allowing fresh=true, so a schema-valid success artifact can carry stale or future per-dependency timestamps. Add binary semantic constraints and negative boundary cases for every checkedAt: finite valid UTC, not after generatedAt, not older than the configured 15-minute limit at generatedAt, and bound to the same run; test the exact limit, one millisecond stale, and one millisecond future.

evidence.snippet: dependencies: exactly 9 unique entries ... fresh: true, UTC checkedAt ...
